summary: The sole occurrence is already the complete Infectum example at 73/355. The thin-cell proposal would duplicate that passage; no example, box or sense is added.
The active first-plural form has an overt head object. The German self-refreshment paraphrase does not establish Detransitive morphology.
Retain homonym rwq 1, its inherited etymology and forms. This source supplies no evidence for the separate hurling homonym.

Does sense 1 require breakfast, or can any coffee/rest pause support mrawəq rišo? The inherited parenthesis durch Frühstück may be narrower than the explicit context, but the single existing quotation does not settle the restriction.

rišan our heads is the affected body-part object in self-refreshment. The supplied context mentions coffee, a cigarette and a pause before setting out; no new meaning follows from the head object alone.
